summary: Increments a scroll-offset counter. Uses the caller-supplied increment a2 unless a2 < 0, in which case the default increment from this+0x178 is used. Adds it to the current offset at this+0x168, stores the sum back, and clamps the result to the maximum bound at this+0x16C. Finally calls UITileGrid(this) to recompute tile positions and returns its result.

operations.description: Select the effective increment: use a2 as given, but when a2 < 0 substitute the default increment value stored at this+0x178 (this[94]).
Compute the new scroll offset v3 = selected increment + current offset this[90] (this+0x168).
Store the computed offset v3 back into this[90] (this+0x168).
Clamp: when v3 exceeds the maximum bound this[91] (this+0x16C), cap this[90] to the maximum value.
Recalculate tile positions by calling UITileGrid(this) after the offset change.
